gates.pass_condition: Acquire a complete separately audited proof with exact r/operation quantifiers, or preserve a correctly scoped no-go without inferring non-QC; universal-negative evidence does not transfer automatically.

gates.title: Historical priority of the exact contact face and sharp boundary
gates.question: Which primary theorem already contains or implies this precise one-sided invariant face/QC result?
gates.pass_condition: Scope-matched primary statements/proofs are compared, including transformed applicability; absence of a search hit is not priority clearance.

gates.title: A changed local/nonlocal operation needs its actual proof
gates.question: Can a proposed escape produce a valid density/integral argument outside the Peano/continuous tangent/all-jet class?
gates.pass_condition: State the changed hypothesis, correct canonical derivative and full nullity/integral guarantee, then prove the desired variational result without inferring it from a failed certificate.

gates.title: Calibrate the actual time-domain target experiment
gates.question: Do actual current/time/voltage/rest/temperature records justify the incremental model and a usable independent voltage/model-discrepancy allowance?
gates.pass_condition: Acquire and align the complete same-cell records, qualify model residuals and safe currents, and compare matched hybrid methods with the same inputs and costs.

gates.title: Exact continuous reference sampling and expected precision costs
gates.question: Can the ideal reference draw and marked coins be implemented with a uniform expected random-bit/precision/runtime bound for the declared family?
gates.pass_condition: Supply a lazy/adaptive exact implementation and expected costs, or retain an explicit finite-error/coupling theorem with every truncation and functional error charged.

gates.title: Compare the equally informed reliability incumbent
gates.question: Does the candidate beat optimized permutation/conditional-holding integration for probability output or other exact bridge methods for path output?
gates.pass_condition: Benchmark identical supplied models, outputs and accuracy including model read/preparation, arithmetic/random-bit precision, repeated queries and reusable structure; report losses.

gates.title: Acquire independent port sources and signed response
gates.question: Can each needed load-port direction actually be driven, calibrated and read with sign while keeping the plant/load map unchanged?
gates.pass_condition: Measured source gain/direction, sign/phase, drift/repeats/settling/reset, control leakage, held-out original-source responses and restricted-model adequacy meet the declared total error budget.

gates.title: Acquire complete-arm same-loop response and safe return
gates.question: Do both full arms on one loop move reversibly under the actual optical/mechanical/electric histories with safe contraction and qualified useful drift?
gates.pass_condition: Independent partial-resolved four-branch acquisition or a demonstrated direct-drive span servo passes useful-output and damage/shape/retention bounds against optimized full-cost controls.
